TOPIC: himachal trips to witness Mountains and Valleys
TARGET_AUDIENCE: Indian parents and millennial group leaders aged 26-36 who organize extended family or friend getaways to Himachal, having saved endless scenic valley reels but stuck balancing conflicting work leaves, kid-friendly pacing, and activity preferences.
PAIN_POINT: Planning a Himachal valley trip across multiple people always derails on mismatched leave dates and split preferences—half the group wants steep Jalori Pass hikes while others want gentle riverside homestay days, turning the WhatsApp group into 50 unread messages with zero consensus.
DESTINATION: Tirthan Valley & Jibhi Circuit, Himachal Pradesh
CREATIVE_ANGLE: They know they want to escape into the Himachal pine valleys together, but nobody can agree on the exact dates or how to balance active hikes with relaxed valley days. Travafa's Group Trip Planning lets members propose specific dates, add activity options like riverside camping or Serolsar Lake walks, and vote directly inside the app to lock in a finalized, democratic itinerary without the group chat chaos.
